libs.note: BH-10102. The console fetch_log reader (bin/fetch-log.sh), on the hub and on every box. Applied by fetch-log.sh itself at start, in a subshell, so a fail-closed exit never stops the read. Not required: no row keeps the env value, else the code fallback (the same numbers as the defaults below).

knobs.note: The newest bytes of a log (no filter), or of the filtered result (match/since/until set), that one fetch_log reads. 5 MiB. 16 MiB is the hard ceiling, in the code too. Was a 16000 literal.

The most bytes of one encoded log_tail beat (the safe tool-response size). 96 KiB: the beat travels as one argv string to bin/beat.sh and curl -d (Linux MAX_ARG_STRLEN 131072) and the far-box row body caps at 256 KiB. The newest lines that fit are sent; the rest are counted in omitted_bytes/omitted_lines with a more call.
